findings.detail: Local Qwen recurrent key/value head counts are equal and depth 128; conv channels 6144 satisfy the locked CUDA multiple-of-128 constraint.

M2 qualified the four mature recurrent routes only for dense F32. The local checkpoint consumes BF16 projection/conv values with F32 recurrent state, so public BF16 schema alone cannot sign the model chain.
No common four-route carrier currently accepts the exact Q4-S128 or Q8-B32 W8A16 contracts. Route-specific Q4 variants are not interchangeable.
Grouped expert, mHC and Lightning Indexer mature operations are bound on four routes, while complete routing/MTP/sparse/compression chains remain unexecuted and cannot inherit primitive PASS.
Only the qualified IREE Vulkan dense F18.1/F18.2 domains are exact; SM89 CUDA, current CPU/Apple candidates and grouped/index F18 domains retain the M2 named rejection boundaries.
